profile_text.body:
SpaceX designs, manufactures and launches advanced rockets and spacecraft, according to its own website. The company was founded in 2002, is headquartered in Hawthorne, California, and is a for-profit company described in its profile as a startup. SpaceX says it was founded to revolutionize space technology, with the ultimate goal of enabling people to live on other planets.

The material available does not describe any AI products or services from the company, and no products are listed for it. Its recorded law exposure is in California, with a count of 264.
